bondPriority.description: Increases Technique DMG by 32% during battle. When Ailment DMG Bonus is equal or higher than 80%, Ailment DMG Bonus is increased by extra 80%.
bondPriority.name: Gin Bond

bondPriority.description: During battle, DMG dealt increases by 8%. This increases to 12% / 16% / 20%, if Crit Rate reaches 20% / 40% / 60%.
bondPriority.name: Toshiro Bond

boundaries.description: Gains 3 Technique Points immediately when entering battle. Fully restores Technique Points after releasing the Ultimate.
boundaries.name: Devouring Mouth

boundaries.description: For every 1 Technique Point consumed, the Crit DMG of the next Ultimate is increased by 35%, stacking up to 6 times. Hitting the enemy with the final strike of the Basic Attack reduces Technique Points recovery time by 2 seconds.
boundaries.name: Manhunt

boundaries.description: The Ultimate inflicts Snake Venom on the enemy, dealing DMG equal to 50% of ATK every second. Snake Venom explodes after 12 seconds, dealing further DMG equal to 40% of the total DMG dealt by Gin during this 12-second period, up to 2500× of Gin's current ATK. While charging a technique, an additional wide-area Thrust attack is released without interrupting the charge (up to 600% of ATK based on charge time).
boundaries.name: Cell Dissolution

corePassives.description: Gin's attacks inflict Impale Scale on the enemy. Upon reaching 100, triggers Impale once, dealing damage equal to 500% of Gin's ATK to the target. Teammates' special attacks, techniques, Battlefield Skills, Ultimates, and counterattacks also inflict 35 Impale Scale on the enemy (1s cooldown). Impale triggered by teammates counts as if triggered by Gin's attacks.

corePassives.name: Disguise

corePassives.description: Each time Impale damage is triggered, Technique Points recovery time is reduced by 5 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds.
